findings.issue: Duplicated API: this PR adds generic twins of declarations that the Clifford file keeps. `TauCeti.Algebra.wordFiltration.previousRestricted` (AssociatedGraded.lean:81) vs `CliffordAlgebra.filtrationPreviousRestricted` (Filtration.lean:156); `GradedPiece` (AssociatedGraded.lean:107) vs `FiltrationGradedPiece` (Filtration.lean:194); and three duplicated theorems: `mem_previousRestricted_iff`/`previousRestricted_zero`/`previousRestricted_succ` (AssociatedGraded.lean:87,94,101) vs `mem_filtrationPreviousRestricted_iff`/`filtrationPreviousRestricted_zero`/`filtrationPreviousRestricted_succ` (Filtration.lean:166,177,188). The PR itself demotes the Clifford copies out of `simp`, documenting them as reachable-through-the-generic duplicates, so both surfaces coexist with no canonical choice; consumers already mix them (PBW.lean:262 uses `associatedGraded (ι Q)` while PBW.lean:311,330,342,351 use `DirectSum.of (FiltrationGradedPiece Q)`).

findings.fix: Add, next to `gradedGOne`/`gradedGMul`, `@[simp] theorem gradedGOne_one : (GradedMonoid.GOne.one : GradedPiece f 0) = gradedOne f := (rfl)`, `@[simp] theorem gradedGMul_mul (x : GradedPiece f i) (y : GradedPiece f j) : GradedMonoid.GMul.mul x y = gradedMul f i j x y := (rfl)`, and an `associatedGraded_of_mul_of` stating the direct-sum product of two homogeneous generators, then replace the `change` steps in PBW.lean with them.
findings.issue: The graded instances expose no characteristic lemma linking them to the named operations, so the new API cannot be used without unfolding: no `GradedMonoid.GOne.one = gradedOne f`, no `GradedMonoid.GMul.mul x y = gradedMul f i j x y`, and no `DirectSum.of _ i x * DirectSum.of _ j y = DirectSum.of _ (i + j) (gradedMul f i j x y)` for `associatedGraded`. Every consumer therefore relies on defeq via `change`.

summary: The PR ships two public names for each of the same objects — the new generic `previousRestricted`/`GradedPiece` (plus their three restatements) alongside the retained Clifford `filtrationPreviousRestricted`/`FiltrationGradedPiece` twins — and the new graded API lacks the lemmas connecting `gradedOne`/`gradedMul` to the `GOne`/`GMul` fields, forcing consumers to unfold by defeq.
